description: Pinned Chai four-stage byte CEDD: 3x3 Gaussian with per-term truncation, Sobel magnitude/direction, strict non-maximum suppression, fixed 10/70 midpoint thresholding. One frame per process; full measured-output CPU verification after timing.

scaling_param.name: width
scaling_param.description: Image width in pixels (W= parameter). Height is set independently via the `height` parameter (default 2048), so the image is not necessarily square; total pixels = width × height.

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Optional shared clock/cache warmer after input upload and scratch initialization, before the first timed stage only. Dependent stages retain naturally evolving state; false leaves the incoming state as-is.
